title: Healthy Habits Every Day
text:
Healthy habits are good for your body. Eat fruit and vegetables every day. Drink a lot of water. Sleep for eight hours at night.

Sport is also important. You can walk, swim or ride a bike. Exercise makes you feel strong and happy. Try to play outside with your friends.

questions.text: What should you eat every day?
What can you do for sport?
options: Walk, swim or ride a bike

questions.text: What is the best way to feel strong and happy?
options: Exercise and play with your friends

questions.text: What is the main idea of the text?
options: Healthy habits make your life better

having a lot of power in your body

paragraph_translations: Zdrowe nawyki są dobre dla twojego ciała. Jedz owoce i warzywa każdego dnia. Pij dużo wody. Śpij osiem godzin w nocy.
Sport jest również ważny. Możesz chodzić, pływać lub jeździć na rowerze. Ćwiczenia sprawiają, że czujesz się silny i szczęśliwy. Staraj się bawić na dworze z przyjaciółmi.
